text: Party B shall pay 10,000,000 VND before 05 May 2024.
If Party B delays payment, a penalty of 1% per day shall apply.
This agreement shall be governed by the laws of Vietnam.
Employee shall maintain confidential information of Employer.
Buyer shall deliver payment to Seller within 10 days.
The Tenant shall pay rent to the Landlord by the due date.
The late fee will be 5% if payment is overdue.
The Contractor shall pay USD 2,500 to the Client.
The effective date of this Agreement is 01 January 2025.
Any dispute shall be resolved under the jurisdiction of Singapore.
